results.title: Мой папа — медведь 2
results.overview: A grown-up Masha decides to arrange a personal life for her father, Misha, which leads to a fight with her father, who pries into matters that don't concern her. Masha, upset with her father, runs away into the forest and ends up with a little bear cub whose parents were kidnapped by poachers. Masha's adventures begin, during which she realizes how difficult it is to be a parent, and most importantly, how difficult it is to raise children.

results.title: My First Love
results.overview: At 19, Ella is ready to begin her adult life on her own terms. Born with a disability and having always used a wheelchair, she dreams of moving into her first apartment when she leaves home to study. Instead, a denied application for assistance forces her into an institution – a crushing blow to her long-awaited independence. Just as the walls of bureaucracy close in, Ella experiences something entirely new: her first love.

results.title: Death in the Making
results.overview: Filmmaker and cinematographer Piotr Pawlus volunteered to the war effort in Ukraine, delivering aid from Poland and transporting civilian refugees.

results.title: Dust
results.overview: When Belgian tech visionaries Luc and Geert learn that their fraud will hit the papers in less than 24 hours, they realise their company and their status will evaporate. With jail time becoming inevitable, they each go on their separate paths of redemption. As they quietly seek atonement from their investors – their families and the close-knit community, they learn what truly matters.

results.title: Cegsex
results.overview: When a mouth erupts on Tomos's arm after trying to bypass online porn restrictions, he must muffle his sins before mum finds out.

results.title: Eddie Romero Remastered: A Century of Filipino Cinema
results.original_title: Eddie Romero Remastered: A Century of Filipino Cinema
results.overview: From low budget B movies to films that outlived trends, Eddie Romero did not wait for permission. He worked with what he had, trusted the story, and kept going. Take after take. Decade after decade.  This is not a victory lap. It is a reminder that cinema moves forward because someone dares to try again.

results.title: Betty St. Clair
results.overview: When an anxious Chinese American drag queen hosts an all-AAPI showcase for an unconventional audience, a surprise guest sends her spiraling into self-doubt. Meanwhile, backstage shenanigans from her chaotic drag family threaten to derail the whole show.

results.title: Fujiko
results.overview: Subjected to harsh treatment by her husband Jiro’s family, Fujiko is devastated when Mari is kidnapped by Jiro’s relatives. With the help of her own mother, Chiyo, Fujiko regains her child. Against the advice and judgment of those around her, she chooses to raise Mari as a single mother.

results.title: The Bindi
results.overview: Trishna, a Bengali actress in France, faces a marriage proposal from home while playing a character with the same dilemma. Torn between love, career, and family pressure, she fights to claim the leading role in her own life.

results.title: What We Carry
results.overview: Stranded in the rural American South, an Ivorian couple must fight to escape an unknown predator.

results.title: Pidha Pachhi...
results.overview: A spontaneous trip takes four friends down a wildly unexpected path after a drunken night ends in missing memories, accidental crimes and nonstop chaos. As they retrace their steps, every discovery makes their hilarious situation even worse.

results.title: The Banning Curse
results.overview: After the critical success of his first film at Cannes, Amiryousefi returned to Iran to find it banned by state authorities. It's a pattern that continued through his entire career, which the seasoned director looks back on in this imaginative, satirical portrait.

results.title: Simon Boccanegra – Dutch National Opera and Ballet
results.original_title: Simon Boccanegra – Dutch National Opera and Ballet
results.overview: The former corsair Simon Boccanegra has risen to power in Genoa but carries the burden of personal loss and old rivalries. He is unexpectedly reunited with his long-lost daughter, and their renewed bond becomes entangled with conflicts involving noble families, love and revenge. Simon struggles to preserve peace in the city while protecting those closest to him. Can he overcome betrayal and reconcile the forces tearing his world apart before it is too late?

results.title: La9cha M smaa
results.overview: An endearing Tunisian loser, a con artist in his spare time, has his life turned upside down when he crosses paths with a shapeshifting alien capable of taking on the appearance of anything he observes.

results.title: I'll be Uruguay
results.overview: Ana, a debutante actress, flees minutes before the premiere of her play due to an anxiety attack. Inside a café, she meets David, who, in an attempt to cheer her up, captivates her with the story of the 1950 World Cup final, Brazil versus Uruguay.

results.title: Finding Joy
results.overview: Roni Gingrich is a PTSD survivor and aspiring artist whose buried childhood trauma manifests in the form of sleep paralysis and recurring dreams as she unravels the truth of her past.

results.title: Put It Back On. Please.
